name: guwu-oj
description: 洛谷风格在线评测系统 | Django + Bootstrap5 开发。支持用户系统、题目库、多语言代码提交（C/C++/Python/Java）、提交记录、排行榜及管理后台。轻量级 OJ，适合编程练习与竞赛训练。Luogu-style Online Judge built with Django & Bootstrap5. Features: user auth, problem set with difficulty tiers, multi-language code submissions (C/C++/Python/Java), submission logs, leaderboard, and admin panel.
